No TS bundle

This is the kolavatar-web placeholder. The Vite-built TS playground hasn't been staged into cmd/kolavatar-web/dist/ for this binary — only the Go playground at /go/ and the SDK API at /v1/avatars/{seed}.{format} are wired up.

To stage the TS bundle, run from the playground repo root:

cd ts && npm run build && cp -r dist/* ../go/cmd/kolavatar-web/dist/
cd ../go && go build -tags=kolavatardev ./cmd/kolavatar-web

The production Dockerfile does this automatically.
